This [[uniform polyhedron compound]] is a symmetric arrangement of 4 [[hexagonal prism]]s, aligned with the axes of threefold rotational symmetry of an [[octahedron]]. It shares the same [[vertex arrangement]] as a nonuniform [[rhombicuboctahedron]].

== Cartesian coordinates ==
[[Cartesian coordinates]] for the vertices of this compound are all the permutations of

: (±1, ±(1−{{radic|6}}), ±(1+{{radic|6}}))
